evals.name: full-inputs-billing
evals.prompt: Write the PRD for the active project. It's the subscription billing work — there's research, a solution spec, and a technical spec already in the librarian. Compile them into a product requirements document.
evals.expected_output: A complete PRD with all sections supported, functional requirements traced to CAP-NN capabilities, NFRs from the technical spec, problem framing from research, a release plan, and a handoff to `librarian.py prd write` with --sources. No fabricated gaps.

evals.name: missing-inputs-upload
evals.prompt: Compile a PRD for the file upload service project. Use whatever's already captured in the librarian.
evals.expected_output: A PRD built from the solution spec, with clearly flagged gaps for the missing research (recommend researcher) and missing technical spec (recommend technical-architect). Proceeds rather than blocking. Functional requirements traced to CAP-NN.

evals.name: missing-research-checkout
evals.prompt: Turn the checkout redesign specs into a product requirements doc and save it to the project.
evals.expected_output: A PRD compiled from solution + technical specs, with the Background/Problem section flagged as a gap (no research, recommend researcher). FRs from capabilities, NFRs from the technical spec, and a handoff to the librarian to persist as the project PRD.
